summary: Documentation only: the v0.32.0 CHANGELOG row links the published release and carries its date (2026-11-12). No code, configuration or workflow change.

findings.evidence: The release tool reads router and agent version from the CHANGELOG row of the tag at the target commit; a wrong row would publish wrong version claims next to the attested binaries.
findings.resolution: Only the tag and date cells change; versions stay 0.28.0 / 0.32.0 as released.

tests.evidence: one line: v0.32.0 (unreleased) -> link to the release, date 2026-11-12.
